ui.accueil_intro: Generate your PSS response in just a few steps, guided by the details of your construction site
ui.accueil_etape1: Identify the construction site → or resume a RePSS you've already started by importing its .json file
ui.accueil_etape2: A number of criteria determine whether an abridged RePSS is sufficient, or whether the full version is required
ui.accueil_etape3: Tick the relevant risks → only the categories corresponding to the trades present on the site are displayed
ui.accueil_etape4: The document is generated with all the required appendices, ready to be uploaded to SharePoint
ui.accueil_credits: Designed by Cédric Comblé, CP1 – Ergonomist

ui.sidebar_info_text: Downloads the current state as a .json file to place in the site's SharePoint folder. To resume later: go back to the identification screen and click "Resume an existing RePSS", then choose this file.
ui.hopital_saisis_code_postal: Enter the site's postcode for an automatic suggestion.
ui.page_explication_texte: This document constitutes the company's response to the Health and Safety Plan (H&SP) established by the safety coordinator for this site. It describes the organisation, prevention measures and risks identified for the works carried out by vma sud. It is generated automatically from the information entered by the project manager and must be filed in the site's SharePoint folder.
ui.carac_chantier_plan_installation: General site layout plan to be attached.
ui.kinney_legende_intro: The Kinney method assesses each risk by multiplying three factors. The resulting score determines the risk level and the prevention measures to be taken.
ui.explication_bloc2_texte: This document must be brought to the attention of all vma sud staff, temporary workers and subcontractors working on this site, as part of the site induction and opening procedure. This information is a legal requirement, to be completed before any work begins on site.
ui.explication_bloc3_texte: This document must be filed in the site's SharePoint folder. Acknowledgement of having read it must be recorded by each person's signature on the “Attendance sheet” (Émargement) page at the end of the document.
